questions.q: Which enzyme initiates the chemical digestion of proteins in the stomach?
questions.explain: Pepsin is the active proteolytic enzyme in the stomach. It is secreted as pepsinogen and activated by hydrochloric acid (HCl) to begin breaking peptide bonds.

questions.q: How many essential amino acids must be obtained from the diet because the human body cannot synthesize them in sufficient quantities?
questions.explain: There are 20 standard amino acids, 9 of which are classified as essential (indispensable) and must be consumed through the diet.

questions.q: What chemical element is found in proteins but not in carbohydrates or fats?
questions.explain: Proteins are distinguished from carbohydrates and fats by the presence of nitrogen in their amine ($-\text{NH}_2$) groups.
